summary: Re-enabled default Semgrep SAST by setting DEFAULT_SAST_SEMGREP_ENABLED=true in src/goal/build-gate.ts and updated the kill-switch comment to reflect baseline suppressions. Updated src/goal/build-gate.test.ts to assert buildDefaultSastCommand returns the expected semgrep command when semgrep is on PATH, preserves null for missing semgrep/empty target paths, and validates quoting behavior. Adjusted two agent-executor orchestration tests to account for the semgrep PATH probe under the re-enabled default. Verification run: pnpm build, pnpm vitest run src/goal/, and pnpm lint (all passing). Committed via scripts/committer as 751d23537.
